title: Vendor says shipment leaves in an hour
scenario: A supplier says a production-critical shipment will miss pickup unless a wire is released within an hour. They attach a revised invoice with new beneficiary details and copy several familiar contacts.

answers.A: Verify the beneficiary change through a known supplier contact and internal approval process before releasing the wire.
answers.B: Escalate the business urgency internally while holding the payment until verification is complete.
answers.C: Send part of the wire to secure the shipment while procurement verifies the rest.

explanation: Operational urgency can make a payment change feel unavoidable. Partial payments are still losses if the destination is fraudulent.
proTip: Protect the payment path first; solve the shipping urgency second.
